newReleases.name: Above the Rails
newReleases.desc:
Hop in the cart and ride an endless coaster through the clouds.

Above the Rails is a one-touch arcade driving game. Hold the gas to build speed, brake before the bends, and keep your cart on the rails as the route climbs, loops and leaps through a floating amusement park in the sky.

EVERY RUN IS DIFFERENT
The track is built fresh each time you play. Climbing spiral sections, long descents, tunnels of pink, neon and cloud, tight chicanes and long sweeping bends keep the ride changing, and it never ends.

SPEED IS YOUR CHOICE
Open it up on the straights, up to 90 km/h, and ease off for the corners. A risk bar shows how close you are to leaving the rails. Take a bend too fast and your cart flies off into the open sky.

LOOPS, JUMPS AND TURBO
Hit the turbo pad and keep your speed up to loop the full 360 degrees. Launch off a ramp across a gap in the sky and land back on the rails. Lift off the gas at the wrong moment and you will fall short.

BIG STARS FOR BRAVE DRIVERS
Collect stars along the way. The big star waiting at the start of a bend is worth three, but only if you take that bend fast.

CHECKPOINTS AND A RECORD THAT MEANS SOMETHING
Pass a checkpoint and you can continue from it after a fall. Your record is your longest clean run without falling, so every stretch counts.

A SKY THAT CHANGES
Start in bright blue daylight and ride on into a red sunset and a starry night above the clouds. Prefer a single mood? Lock the sky to day, sunset or night in the settings.

newReleases.desc:
Velyrix is a mirror-movement snake puzzle set in a moonlit garden. One swipe guides two magical serpents at once. Lumen, the emerald serpent, moves on the top board. Umbra, the violet serpent, moves on the board below. Up and down are shared. Left and right are mirrored. Land both heads in their golden nests on the same move.

HOW TO PLAY
- Swipe, or tap the arrows, to move both serpents together.
- Up moves both up. Down moves both down.
- Left sends Lumen left and Umbra right. Right does the opposite.
- Eat every glowing berry. A nest counts only after its board is clear.
- If one serpent is home and the other is not, keep going until they arrive together.
- If a wall, the board edge, or a serpent’s own body blocks either path, neither serpent moves.

THE GARDEN
Twelve handcrafted gardens open one by one, from a first straight glance to the Velyrix Orchard. Stones, hedges, berries, and mirrored trails ask you to plan a single path that works for both serpents. Finish a garden at or under par to earn three stars. A few extra moves still count. Undo, restart, and hints are always there, and a hint never spoils your stars.

Your progress stays on this device: gardens cleared, best paths, and stars collected.

Velyrix is a calm puzzle for a quiet moment. Watch both boards, choose one swipe, and bring the twin serpents home together.

HOW IT WORKS
Type any word. Vicino shows its rank — how close it is to the target word in meaning. A low rank means hot, a high rank means still far off. Colour helps too, but it's never the only signal — the rank always shows as a number as well.

GAME MODES
• Daily puzzle: one new word a day, the same for everyone. See how you compare on the worldwide leaderboard.
• Endless: as many puzzles as you like, any time, no internet connection needed.
• Archive: catch up on daily puzzles you missed, any time.
• Multiplayer rooms: invite 1 to 7 friends with a link and guess the same word together — whoever reaches the best ranks leads live.

HELP WHEN YOU'RE STUCK
A hint gives you a word that's closer to the target than your best guess so far. Once you solve it, the word bridge shows a path of neighbouring words from your first guess to the target — to retrace and to share.

FIVE LANGUAGES
Choose your puzzle language independently of your device language: German, English, French, Spanish or Italian. Each language has its own vocabulary and its own puzzles.
